events.name: Bangor Comedy Festival- Festival Passes
events.description:
Be part of history as we launch the first-ever Bangor Comedy Festival, a weekend dedicated to stand-up comedy, comedy education, and unforgettable live entertainment. Featuring nationally touring comedians, local talent, comedy workshops, and late-night events, this inaugural festival brings two full days of laughs to the Queen City.
Whether you're a lifelong comedy fan, an aspiring comedian, or simply looking for a unique weekend experience, the First Bangor Comedy Festival offers something for everyone.

FRIDAY, OCTOBER 23
🎤 6:00PM Comedy Class Graduation Showcase Kick off the festival by supporting the next generation of comedians as local students take the stage for their graduation performance and official comedy debut.
🤣 8:00PM Stand-Up Comedy Showcase Featuring Ray Harrington One of New England's most respected and accomplished comedians headlines Friday night with his signature blend of storytelling, sharp observations, and laugh-out-loud humor.
🔞 11:00PM Late Night R-Rated Comedy Show When the lights go down, the comedy gets a little edgier. This adults-only late-night showcase features uncensored comedy from some of the festival's funniest performers.

SATURDAY, OCTOBER 24
✍️3:00PM Afternoon Joke Writing Workshop Ever wanted to write comedy? Learn the fundamentals of crafting jokes, finding humor in everyday life, and developing your own comedic voice in this interactive afternoon session.
🎤 8:00 PM Stand-Up Comedy Showcase Featuring Jimmy Cash Saturday night's featured performance brings one of the region's funniest comedians to the Bangor Comedy Festival stage for a night of big laughs and memorable moments.
🔥11:00PM Late Night Roast Battle The inaugural festival closes with its most unpredictable event. Comedians face off in a battle of insults, wit, and crowd-pleasing burns where nobody is safe and everyone laughs.

Join Comedy History in Bangor
The First Bangor Comedy Festival isn't just another weekend of entertainment. It's the beginning of what promises to become a new Bangor tradition. Come celebrate the launch of Bangor's newest festival, discover great comedians, and be able to say you were there for the very first one.
Six Events. Two Days. One Historic Weekend of Laughs.
Some events contain mature content and may be intended for audiences 18+.
WHEN PURCHASING TICKETS CONFRIM YOU ARE BUYING FOR THE CORRECT PERFORMENCE. NO REFUNDS.

events.description:
Be part of history as we launch the first-ever Bangor Comedy Festival, a weekend dedicated to stand-up comedy, comedy education, and unforgettable live entertainment. Featuring nationally touring comedians, local talent, comedy workshops, and late-night events, this inaugural festival brings two full days of laughs to the Queen City.
Whether you're a lifelong comedy fan, an aspiring comedian, or simply looking for a unique weekend experience, the First Bangor Comedy Festival offers something for everyone.

FRIDAY, OCTOBER 23
🎤 6:00PM Comedy Class Graduation Showcase Kick off the festival by supporting the next generation of comedians as local students take the stage for their graduation performance and official comedy debut.
🤣 8:00PM Stand-Up Comedy Showcase Featuring Ray Harrington One of New England's most respected and accomplished comedians headlines Friday night with his signature blend of storytelling, sharp observations, and laugh-out-loud humor.
🔞 11:00PM Late Night R-Rated Comedy Show When the lights go down, the comedy gets a little edgier. This adults-only late-night showcase features uncensored comedy from some of the festival's funniest performers.

SATURDAY, OCTOBER 24
✍️3:00PM Afternoon Joke Writing Workshop Ever wanted to write comedy? Learn the fundamentals of crafting jokes, finding humor in everyday life, and developing your own comedic voice in this interactive afternoon session.
🎤 8:00 PM Stand-Up Comedy Showcase Featuring Jimmy Cash Saturday night's featured performance brings one of the region's funniest comedians to the Bangor Comedy Festival stage for a night of big laughs and memorable moments.
🔥11:00PM Late Night Roast Battle The inaugural festival closes with its most unpredictable event. Comedians face off in a battle of insults, wit, and crowd-pleasing burns where nobody is safe and everyone laughs.

Join Comedy History in Bangor
The First Bangor Comedy Festival isn't just another weekend of entertainment. It's the beginning of what promises to become a new Bangor tradition. Come celebrate the launch of Bangor's newest festival, discover great comedians, and be able to say you were there for the very first one.
Six Events. Two Days. One Historic Weekend of Laughs.
Some events contain mature content and may be intended for audiences 18+.

generalInfo.generalRule: All guests are subject to search prior to entering the Cross Insurance Center. The Cross Insurance Center uses metal detectors for all events. Guests will be subject to a secondary screening if alarm sounds going through the metal detectors (this may slow entry into the venue). Any guest who declines to be searched, or is in possession of prohibited items, may be denied entry to the Cross Insurance Center. The Cross Insurance Center has a Bag Policy for all events.
